_comment: THE PROVIDER SPI, frozen. This file belongs to no provider.
Until P1.0 the only written form of this contract lived inside one
provider's test directory, as fixtures/deepwiki/spi/routes.json — a
recording of what the legacy DeepWiki plugin happened to serve, mixed with
that plugin's own handler file names. You cannot generalise a runner
against a contract that is indistinguishable from one implementation's
notes, so the generic half is lifted out here and the recording stays where
it was.
WHAT MAKES A PATH GENERIC. It is in this file when every provider must
serve it to be admitted. /ui/<path> is NOT here: it is DeepWiki's vendored
SPA, and ADR-0022 decision 8 moved it behind an authenticated elitea-main
handler.
THE PLATFORM SERVES A SUBSET, and that is recorded rather than smoothed
over. elitea-main's facade proxies three of these five paths. /descriptor
and /health are consumed by the admission and health planes, which answer
501 today (internal/api/v2/.../service_descriptors.go). Listing them as
`facade: null` is what makes implementing one a deliberate act: the parity
gate fails when the Go side grows a path this file does not describe, AND
when a path here claims a facade route the OpenAPI document does not
declare.

paths.purpose: the provider's self-description: toolkits, tools, argument schemas
paths.facade_absent_because: consumed by the admission plane, which answers 501 today

paths.purpose: liveness plus which runner is active
paths.facade_absent_because: consumed by the health projection, which does not exist yet

paths.purpose: the provider's per-project capacity and current occupancy
